violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. Observed no CFM at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrives 15 min after

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.Observed no paper towel in back handsink, and front handsink
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.CFM provided paper towels

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the back being used hold bucket with towels.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CFM removed the bucket.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no soap in the back handsink
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.CFM provided soap.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3-compartment piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. CFM called the plumber to repaired the wash compartment sink and will use the rinse to wash, and rinse.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: oven handle, mixing equipment,
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Hot water at the hand sink and mop is turn off to be repaired.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.
